study.hypothesis: Fixed literature-inspired short-horizon reversal, residual reversal, and distance-pairs portfolios may exhibit out-of-sample mean reversion after realistic fractional-share sizing, turnover, financing, borrow, and leverage stress.

references.citation: Jegadeesh, N. (1990), Evidence of Predictable Behavior of Security Returns, Journal of Finance 45(3)
Da, Z., Liu, Q., and Schaumburg, E. (2014), A Closer Look at the Short-Term Return Reversal, Management Science 60(3)
Gatev, E., Goetzmann, W., and Rouwenhorst, K. (2006), Pairs Trading: Performance of a Relative-Value Arbitrage Rule, Review of Financial Studies 19(3)
